finland-s-htp-value-which-employers-1t1q: Finland''s HTP value, which employers must take into account, is lower: 0.05 mg/m³.
latvia-s-law-gives-this-limit-1wvuaxj: Latvia''s law gives this limit for the inhalable fraction of the dust.
dust-masks-in-japan-pass-a-1yvkm6r: Dust masks in Japan pass a national test (国家検定). DS masks are disposable and RS masks take replaceable filters; class 2 filters at least 95.0% of the test particles, class 3 at least 99.9%.
tu-rkiye-has-not-adopted-the-11m2j0x: Türkiye has not adopted the EU''s binding limit (Directive (EU) 2017/2398). Tridymite has the same limit as cristobalite: half the value for quartz.
tu-rkiye-s-rules-for-protective-thzk4t: Türkiye''s rules for protective equipment follow the EU''s (Regulation (EU) 2016/425).
this-is-an-exposure-standard-employers-1: This is an exposure standard (노출기준): employers must measure the dust at work and act when it is over the standard, but crystalline silica is not among Korea''s binding limits (허용기준).
dust-masks-for-work-in-korea-s8e7ic: Dust masks for work in Korea (방진마스크) carry the KOSHA safety certification mark (안전인증). A 1급 filtering-facepiece mask filters at least 94.0% of the test particles, a 특급 one at least 99.0%. KF94 masks are health masks approved by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, not certified dust masks for work.
until-31-december-2026-an-earlier-1vi8kw: Until 31 December 2026 an earlier table applies, in which the limit depends on how much silica the dust contains. We have not read that table on an official page, so it is not shown here.
disposable-dust-masks-in-taiwan-are-13vq: Disposable dust masks in Taiwan are graded under the national standard CNS 14755 (拋棄式防塵口罩).
tridymite-s-limit-is-the-same-1gu6h6l: Tridymite''s limit is the same as cristobalite''s.
malaysia-s-guidelines-use-the-us-1axxdoc: Malaysia''s guidelines use the US (NIOSH) classes, and also accept masks certified to the Australian and New Zealand (AS/NZS 1716), European (EN 149), Korean and Japanese standards.
these-are-for-respirable-dust-any-kjfn15: These are for respirable dust (呼尘). Any dust with 10% free silica or more is held to these limits.
pieces-first-sold-before-1-december-1wdx: Pieces first sold before 1 December 2026 under the old rules may be sold until stocks run out.
a-cup-or-mug-must-meet-13iki3j: A cup or mug must meet both the limit for its rim and the limit for pieces that can be filled.
austria-also-limits-zinc-antimony-and-go: Austria also limits zinc, antimony and barium.
these-limits-are-for-imported-ware-18xl8: These limits are for imported ware; we found no official limit for ware made in Australia.
cooking-ware-means-pieces-made-mainly-c2: Cooking ware means pieces made mainly for cooking over a direct flame, in an oven or in a microwave. Pieces warmed in hot water or used at no more than 100 °C, such as sake warmers (tokkuri) and chawanmushi cups, are not cooking ware, nor are pieces only for reheating in a microwave.
at-least-three-samples-are-tested-dficvw: At least three samples are tested: the ware passes if their average is within the limit and no single sample is more than 50% over it.
singapore-s-rule-gives-limits-for-1pzzw5: Singapore''s rule gives limits for lead only; cadmium falls under its general ban on vessels that can impart lead, cadmium or any other toxic substance.
cooking-ware-means-ceramic-ware-meant-lv: Cooking ware means ceramic ware meant to be heated, conventionally or in a microwave.
sells-to-private-buyers-in-germany-10bqx: Sells to private buyers in Germany only.
orders-by-quote-or-in-the-plkiwi: Orders by quote, or in the shop.
orders-by-form-without-a-cart-pqvm3c: Orders by form, without a cart.
orders-by-phone-or-email-from-15gr0rm: Orders by phone or email, from a price list.
orders-by-email-from-a-price-1fm0gf9: Orders by email, from a price list.
ask-the-shop-whether-an-item-64c6w2: Ask the shop whether an item is in stock before buying.
